A1_future_observation_injected.attack: Future observation injected before availability time
A1_future_observation_injected.detail: Availability engine checks as_of_time >= event_time + shift. Future observations blocked.

A2_missing_availability_defaults.attack: Missing availability timestamp defaults to usable
A2_missing_availability_defaults.detail: Fail-closed: unknown availability defaults to NOT_AVAILABLE.

A3_revised_labeled_original.attack: Revised value labeled as original vintage
A3_revised_labeled_original.detail: Vintage identity tracked. Revision metadata prevents mislabeling.

A4_snapshot_overwritten.detail: Snapshots are immutable. New data creates new snapshot.

A5_raw_source_modified.detail: Raw store is IMMUTABLE. Checksums verified on reuse.

A6_dataset_identity_collision.detail: Collision test verified. IDs are deterministic from inputs.

A7_transform_without_version.detail: Transformation version is part of dataset identity. Change = new ID.

A8_feature_references_nonexistent.detail: Dataset assembly validates snapshot existence before feature computation.

A9_duplicate_conflicting_values.detail: Schema validation rejects duplicate (instrument, timestamp) keys.

A10_timestamp_timezone_ambiguity.detail: All timestamps consistently naive (assumed UTC). Policy documented.

A12_unknown_pit_enters_confirmatory.detail: Access controls block UNKNOWN_PIT from confirmatory research.

A13_unsafe_bypasses_access.attack: UNSAFE data bypasses research access controls
A13_unsafe_bypasses_access.detail: UNSAFE_FOR_HISTORICAL_CONFIRMATION blocked from all confirmatory use.

A14_availability_lag_removed.attack: Availability lag removed after favorable result
A14_availability_lag_removed.detail: Availability policy is part of locked dataset identity. Cannot change silently.

A15_experiment_reads_latest_revised.attack: Historical experiment silently reads latest revised dataset
A15_experiment_reads_latest_revised.detail: Experiments reference immutable snapshots, not mutable datasets.

A16_lineage_chain_broken.detail: Lineage is recorded at each layer. Broken chain detected.

A17_missing_raw_but_processed_exists.attack: Missing raw artifact but processed artifact exists
A17_missing_raw_but_processed_exists.detail: Raw store checksums verified. Missing raw = invalid processed.

A18_snapshot_digest_mismatch.detail: SHA-256 digest verified. Mismatch = corruption detected.
